records.notes: FEEDBACK LOOP RECORD. Source phase: 6 (Retail, Cleo). Target phase: 0 (Collection, cooperatives). Mechanism: 1 EUR per 100g shea butter sold at retail triggers Phase 0 cooperative income payment. Effect on Phase 0 C-parameters: income_certainty 15→75, market_access 20→70. Resulting N-state improvement: 90.4 → 200.1 (+121%). This is the structural cross-phase correction that the Cleo retail mechanism delivers — modeled here as a C-parameter uplift at Phase 0 driven by a Phase 6 event.
